C06 and C12 share nearly the same machinery and phrasing, but C04 is the closest literal and structural match.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The statutory period of limitations, which the Congress has included in the revenue system as a matter of sound policy, is essential to the achievement of finality in tax administration.","parent_excerpt":"The statutory period of limitations, which the Congress has included in the revenue system as a matter of sound policy, is essential in order to achieve finality in tax administration.","explanation":"This is an almost verbatim policy sentence, including the distinctive sequence linking the congressionally imposed limitations period, sound policy, and finality in tax administration."},{"child_excerpt":"To grant special relief in this case would be to discriminate against other similarly situated taxpayers and to create an undesirable precedent.","parent_excerpt":"Accordingly, to grant special relief in this case, where a refund was not claimed in the time and manner prescribed by law, would be to discriminate against such other similarly situated taxpayers and to create an undesirable precedent.","explanation":"The child closely preserves C04’s two-part conclusion—discrimination against similarly situated taxpayers and creation of an undesirable precedent—while omitting only the case-specific qualification."},{"child_excerpt":"This bill would permit the filing of a tax refund claim that was in fact filed after the deadline date set by law.","parent_excerpt":"These claims were rejected because filed after the expiration of the 3-year period of limitations prescribed by law for the filing of such claims.","explanation":"Both directives use the same administrative mechanism: a private bill overriding the legally prescribed deadline for a tax-refund claim, followed by rejection on finality and equal-treatment grounds."}]}
